name: Posa Ristorante & Vineria
notes: Menu and prices from Posa's own Toast ordering page, which the restaurant's website links to as its online menu. The website's menu pages currently return 'page not found', and its wine page is only a photo gallery, so wines are not listed. The 'Featured Items' section repeated dishes from other sections and is left out. Rigatoni al Ragù was marked out of stock but is kept. The address was wrong on the old page (416 Main St); Posa is at 90 Danbury Rd. Phone and hours are from the website.
taglineEn: Amalfi Coast Italian cooking, Neapolitan pizza and housemade pasta in Ridgefield
